summary: Mount Logan Capital filed an 8-K after its subsidiary MLC US Holdings entered Amendment No. 6 to its August 2021 Credit Agreement, waiving defaults tied to the merger of Alternative Credit Income Fund into BC Partners Lending Corporation on September 29, 2026. The ACIF advisory contract with Sierra Crest Investment Management, 24.99% owned by Mount Logan, terminated; BC Partners Advisors agreed to pay SCIM 29.88% of management and incentive fees, and SCIM assigned those rights to MLC Sub to retire a $15.0 million promissory note pledged as collateral. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch collateral value and any lingering covenant issues.
